chunks: My father and a group of my scholars narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Alī Al-Būfaki, from someone who narrated to him, from Sandal, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a person who neglects the Ziyārah (visitation) of the grave of al-Ḥusayn ibn ‘Alī (peace be upon him) without any excuse. He said: 'This is a man from the inhabitants of Hell.'

key_terms.الزِّيَارَةَ: Visitation (Ziyarah), specifically referring to visiting the graves of Imams and saints
key_terms.قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: The grave of al-Husayn ibn Ali
key_terms.مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ: Without a valid excuse or reason

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who neglects visiting the grave of Imam Husayn without a valid reason?
ai.summary: Compiled by Ibn Qulawayh in *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith underscores the gravity of neglecting the pilgrimage to Karbala, linking it directly to eternal damnation. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on Ziyārah not merely as a ritual, but as a vital act of loyalty (Wilayah) to the Ahl al-Bayt, where absence without valid excuse signifies a spiritual deficiency.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali Al-Būfaki, from someone who narrated to him, from Sandal, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about a person who neglects going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) without any reason. Imam (a.s.) replied, “Such a person will be from the inhabitants of Hell.”
